findings.label: Positional path ignored by `adx tokens`
findings.detail: `adx tokens ./my.json` parses `./my.json` into args.dir and silently discards it, falling back to the bundled set; only `--tokens` is honored. Matches the documented `adx tokens [--tokens <path>]` signature, so non-blocking, but a user typo could print the wrong tokens with no warning. Consider a future note or positional support.

findings.label: No automated test for CWD-independent default path
findings.detail: The import.meta.url resolution that makes a global install print the bundled tokens from any CWD is exercised only by the recorded manual /tmp run, not by a test. In-process run() tests pass regardless of CWD, so a regression to a process.cwd()-relative default would not be caught. Consider a test that invokes the built dist/cli.js from a foreign CWD.
